(b) Cumulative bottle-drop rates over control steps after mid-task takeover. Some policies leave the task unfinished but drop the bottle. Events are recorded until rollout termination.

Figure 3:Overview of SAFI. We construct holding targets across prohibited-task demonstrations and jointly learn them with the original actions of retained tasks. Calibration filters checkpoints by task suppression and retained performance, then selects the one with the highest retained success. The response audit compares SAFI with baselines from initial and takeover states, examining task completion and physical outcomes.

Figure 8:Trajectories after matched mid-task takeover. Columns show the same elapsed control steps across methods. Original completes both prohibited tasks. NPO-RT drops the bottle and activates the stove, while SAFI keeps the bottle held and the stove off. Each panel ends at Original’s task completion.
